data.name: Slop Slop
data.detailed_description:
Slop Slop

The swamp is hungry. The hut demands tribute. And you? You're just trying to survive.

Slop Slop is a co-op survival game for up to 8 players. Each day, a mysterious hut in the swamp demands a new offering of food. Fail to deliver, and… well, let's just say the swamp doesn't do eviction notices.

☀️ By day, scavenge the swamp for whatever slop the hut craves. Explore randomly generated levels, uncover strange mysteries, and try not to wander too far from your friends.

🌙 By night, everything gets worse. If you're not back at the hut by sundown, the creatures come out — and they hit hard. Still out when night ends? You're dead. No refunds.

🎙️ Talk it out — location-based voice chat means you can only hear teammates nearby. Screaming for help is encouraged but may not reach anyone.

👥 Bring friends — host a game directly from your machine. No servers, no matchmaking queues, no excuses. Just you, your friends, and a very demanding hut.

The difficulty escalates. The swamp gets stranger. The hut gets hungrier.

Good luck out there. You'll need it.
